description: FREE. Directory of companies we hold SEC iXBRL financial statements for, optionally filtered by ticker or company name. Returns ticker, company, CIK, latest reported period and pre/post-IPO period counts — use it to find which tickers get_company_financials can return. Paged: limit (default 200, max 500) and offset; the response carries total and nextOffset (null on the last page).

offset.description: Rows to skip. Pass the previous response's nextOffset to fetch the next page.

query.description: Filter by ticker or company name (case-insensitive substring). Omit to list every covered company.

name: lookup_companies_with_financials

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key: the registrant's permanent SEC identifier, as a 10-digit string with leading zeros, e.g. 0001876042.

company.description: Registrant name as filed with the SEC, e.g. Circle Internet Group, Inc.

latestPeriodEnd.description: End date of the most recent period we hold, YYYY-MM-DD. Shows how current the statements are.

postIpoCount.description: How many periods we hold from the 10-K, 10-Q and 20-F reports filed after the listing. 0 for a company that has not reported as a public company yet. Returned as postIpoPeriods.

preIpoCount.description: How many periods (annual and interim) we hold from before the listing, read from the registration statement. 0 when we hold none. The financials endpoint returns them as preIpoPeriods.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol the company trades under now, upper case, e.g. CRCL.

data.description: Companies we hold SEC financial statements for, sorted by ticker.

nextOffset.description: Pass as offset to get the next page. Null on the last page.

total.description: Rows matching the query across all pages.

title: Companies with SEC financials (free)
